title: The Yang-Mills Mass Gap from One Bound at One Scale
description: We prove the mass gap of four-dimensional lattice Yang-Mills theory at strong coupling for every compact simple gauge group, with explicit bounds. For the continuum theories built on tori we prove that a mass gap and a unique vacuum follow from one bound on partition functions at one physical scale, and that this bound is equivalent to a lattice gap together with a Stefan-Boltzmann bound on the thermal free energy. That bound is open at weak coupling, and the unrenormalised loop variables have a trivial limit. The archive contains the paper, a Lean 4 project (279 theorems) and a Julia script (245 checks). The continuum mass gap is not proved.
